buckets.title: Fitness & Fatigue
buckets.text: A slight edge to Lepchenko on freshness. De Reales has logged 147 games across 7 matches in 14 days, Lepchenko only 104 across 4. Over the last 7 days it is 4 matches for De Reales against 3 for Lepchenko.

buckets.title: Motivation & Pressure
buckets.text: Motivation and pressure point fairly clearly to De Reales. Both are gaining ground, but De Reales faster: +119 Elo over 90 days against +21 for Lepchenko. Deciding-set record under pressure: De Reales 77%, Lepchenko 57%.

buckets.title: Conditions
buckets.text: A slight edge to De Reales on conditions. De Reales is the more proven player on Clay: 67% wins in 12 months against 52% for Lepchenko. De Reales has 22 matches on Clay in the last 90 days, Lepchenko only 5, so the adjustment period is shorter. Offsetting that, both rate above their overall level on Clay, Lepchenko by more (+54 Elo against +17 for De Reales).
